description: Asking to keep the Mac awake for a while maps to system/keep_awake, and because it is a medium-risk mutation it must STAGE (return a token) rather than auto-run in the same turn — staging does not start caffeinate, so this is CI-safe. Distinct from display_sleep (turns the screen OFF) and sleep_assertions (only reports what is keeping it awake).
prompt: Keep my Mac awake for the next hour so it doesn't fall asleep during my download.

description: Asking why the Mac won't sleep / what is keeping it awake maps to system/sleep_assertions, a read-only probe that runs immediately (pmset -g assertions) with no stage/execute round trip. It must not route to keep_awake (which CAUSES wakefulness) or power_status (battery).
prompt: Why won't my Mac go to sleep? What's keeping it awake right now?
